title: Elevated Turkish Meat Lahmacun
description: A kid-friendly Turkish dish featuring buttery, bouncy-qq crust. Made with 00-flour and Binchotan charcoal, this recipe is Whole30 friendly and perfect for a quick, weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef
ingredients.notes: 80/20 lean to fat ratio for moisture and flavor.

ingredients.name: Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: A mix of paprika, cumin, and cinnamon.

instructions: Combine flour, water, yeast, and salt in a large mixing bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the Binchotan charcoal grill to 500°F (260°C).
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on the size of lahmajoun you prefer.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/16 inch thick.
Place the dough on the grill, brush with olive oil, and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to curl.
Top the dough with ground beef, onion, garlic, and spice blend.
Return the lahmajoun to the grill and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and the filling is cooked through.
Remove the lahmajoun from the grill and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling ingredients.
Serve the lahmajoun hot, garnished with fresh parsley or sumac, if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
